prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a sideswipe while changing lanes. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1277; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The vehicle damage matches the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Vehicle inspected at the shop following a sideswipe that occurred during a lane change. The damage to the right rear quarter panel, rear bumper cover, and tail lamp assembly lines up well with the impact as described, and the scrape pattern runs in a consistent direction across the panels. No prior damage to this vehicle is known, and the paint and body work shows no signs of older repairs. The proposed repair plan is to replace the tail lamp and bumper cover, repair and refinish the quarter panel, and blend adjacent paint. The labor hours requested are in line with the extent of the damage. The billing submitted shows no repeated charges for the same operations.
